evals.prompt: Use $refactor-arch to audit this Flask shop API. Show exact findings and a plan; wait for my confirmation before changing sources.
evals.expected_output: Stack/domain inventory; exact ordered findings; no application changes until explicit confirmation; then scoped MVC refactor with all original routes validated.
assertions: Reports correct stack and domain from observed sources
Contains at least five evidenced findings including HIGH/CRITICAL, two MEDIUM and two LOW
Preserves application source hashes at the confirmation boundary
After approval, boots and exercises every original method/path
Contains no private transcripts or secret values in report
